sentence_stem: Although the ending surprised the readers,
correct_completion: many of them found it deeply satisfying.
full_sentence: Although the ending surprised the readers, many of them found it deeply satisfying.
acceptable_variants: most of them still enjoyed the story.
many readers praised the author's courage.

options.text: so they stopped reading the book.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' introduces contrast, not cause. A result clause with 'so' does not show the contrast the connector requires.

options.text: the story was written in the past tense.
options.why_wrong: This gives a grammatical fact about the story but does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

options.text: many of them found it deeply satisfying.
the author wrote a second chapter.
options.why_wrong: This adds new information but does not express the reaction contrasting with the surprise that 'although' sets up.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must express a result that contrasts with the first part of the sentence. Portuguese speakers may reach for a cause-and-effect connector here, because Portuguese often uses the same connector family for both contrast and cause, so the English concessive pattern needs to be practised separately.
translation: Embora o final tenha surpreendido os leitores, muitos deles o acharam muito satisfatório.
